summary: Mobile app (likely grocery/delivery) with shop management features. User is redesigning the home page with a sliding banner, 2-column product grid, sticky bottom navigation, and relocated mobile recharge section.
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Colorful 'Coming Soon' illustration with stars and a shopping basket on a light background, suitable for an empty product grid state (coming-soon.dim_400x300.png)

existing_features.title: Redesign the HomePage layout so that: (1) a compact auto-sliding banner carousel appears at the very top (reduce banner height to approximately 140–160px on mobile), (2) the ProductGrid appears immediately below the banner with no intervening sections, and (3) the MobileRechargeSection is relocated to the bottom of the page as a compact icon-based grid or small card (e.g., a row of operator icons with a label), above the footer.

Redesign the product display in ProductGrid to use a strict 2-column grid layout. Each ProductCard must display: a clean product image, the product name in bold, a green 'Delivery in 10 Mins' tag, and a prominent green '+ ADD' button. When no products are found (empty state), render a visually appealing 'Coming Soon' graphic/illustration with descriptive text instead of plain text.

Add a Sticky Bottom Navigation Bar fixed to the bottom of the viewport with 4 navigation items: Home, Search, My Orders, and Wallet — each with an appropriate icon and label. The bar must appear on all customer-facing pages. Also add a small floating WhatsApp Help button (WhatsApp green, bottom-right corner) that opens a WhatsApp chat link when tapped. Ensure the sticky nav does not overlap page content (add appropriate bottom padding to page layouts).

new_feature_requests.summary: Redesign Home Page: sliding banner at top, move Mobile Recharge to small icon-grid/card at bottom, products appear immediately after banner, decrease banner height
Product Grid: 2-column layout with clean image, bold product name, 'Delivery in 10 Mins' green tag, prominent green '+ADD' button, and 'Coming Soon' graphic when no products found
Sticky Bottom Navigation Bar with 4 icons (Home, Search, My Orders, Wallet) and a floating WhatsApp Help button on bottom right
